svg.title: RAG in two steps
svg.desc: Index once: files are cut into chunks, turned into 384 numbers each by bge-small, and stored in a sqlite-vec file. Every question: the question is turned into numbers, the closest chunks are found, and the model answers from them and names the source files.

g.text: Index once: ovat index reads a folder of .md and .txt files.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each file is cut into short passages, called chunks.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A small model, bge-small, turns each chunk into 384 numbers that stand for its meaning.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: They are saved in one sqlite-vec file. If a file changes later, OVAT tells you.

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the question is turned into 384 numbers the same way,

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the chunks whose numbers are closest are pulled from the index,

text.style: font:500 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;letter-spacing:.06em
font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: and the model answers from them. OVAT prints the source files itself.

text.style: font:400 13.5px Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Index once: files to chunks to 384 numbers to sqlite-vec. Each question: embed, find the closest chunks, answer with sources.
